parsed.name: Specim短波红外相机
parsed.description: 一种短波红外成像相机，用于采集样品在SWIR波段的图像数据，常见于材料识别、分选、农业检测以及科研成像实验。
parsed.description_en: A short-wave infrared imaging camera used to acquire sample images in the SWIR range, commonly used for material identification, sorting, agricultural inspection, and research imaging experiments.
